# Bluepeek

> Bluepeek is a digital growth agency based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, working with local businesses across Australia. It helps businesses get found, generate leads, convert customers and build their online reputation through Google Ads, Meta Ads, high-converting websites, Google Reviews, Google Business Profile management, SEO, social media and AI follow-up automation.

## Key facts
- Business name: Bluepeek
- Founders and owners: Jac Thomas-Rees and Zach Colville. Clients deal directly with the founders.
- Based at: 7 Gidgee Court, Molendinar QLD 4214 (Gold Coast)
- Serves: the Gold Coast and all of Australia
- Contact: info@bluepeek.com.au, Jac 0402 923 253, Zach 0468 955 806
- Website: https://www.bluepeek.com.au
- Websites: custom built, mobile-first, most go live in 1 to 2 weeks once content is ready; clients own their domain, site and content; no lock-in contracts.
- Reviews: Bluepeek never gates Google reviews by star rating and does not publish invented results or testimonials.

## The Bluepeek growth system
1. Get found: Google Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile
2. Get attention: Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), organic social media
3. Convert: websites, landing pages, lead forms, calls
4. Follow up: AI automation, CRM, automated lead follow-up
5. Build trust: Google Reviews, NFC review cards and plaques, reputation

## NFC review product
Bluepeek Reviews cards and plaques (https://bluepeekreviews.com) open a business's Google review form with a tap or QR scan. Peek Card $39, Peek Wall Plaque $49, Peek Stand $59 (prices as of September 2026). Links are managed server-side, so a card never needs reprogramming. Tracking counts taps and clicks through to Google, not reviews posted.
